svg.title: Three rules I design AI by: It shows its sources — Every field the AI fills is marked, with where it came from.; It says when it doesn't know — “Not found” beats a confident guess.; A person decides — Accept or discard in one click. The call stays human.

g.text: THREE RULES I DESIGN AI BY · FROM ATLAS
Every field the AI fills is marked,
It says when it doesn't know
